name: Copper/Gold Ratio Momentum & SPY Forward Returns
description: Quartile-sorts the copper/gold ratio 60-day ROC using a 252-day rolling percentile rank. Assigns each day to Q1 (most falling) through Q4 (most rising). Shows average 3-month (63-day) SPY forward returns and hit rates for each quartile to test whether extreme rising copper/gold (Q4) predicts meaningfully better SPY returns than extreme falling (Q1).
source:
# =============================================================================
# COPPER/GOLD RATIO MOMENTUM → SPY FORWARD RETURNS
# =============================================================================
# Signal: 60-day ROC of the copper/gold ratio (HG/GC)
# Quartile: rolling 252-day percentrank → Q1 (bottom 25%) to Q4 (top 25%)
# Outcome: 63-day (3-month) SPY forward returns by quartile
#
# Design notes:
#   - NoAdjustment for both HG and GC (cross-commodity ratio — D16)
#   - LiquidityBased rollover for both
#   - percentrank returns 0-100; quartile thresholds at 25/50/75
#   - Hit rate = % of days where 63d forward return > 0
#   - Summary table: N, Median, Hit Rate, Best, Worst per quartile
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: Copper (HG) ---
hg_raw = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

# --- Data: Gold (GC) ---
gc_raw = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# --- Data: SPY ---
spy = reference_stocks(ticker='SPY')()
spy_close = spy.c

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio ---
# NoAdjustment preserves true price relationships for ratio (D16)
hg_close = ffill(hg.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc.c)
cg_ratio = hg_close / gc_close

# --- Signal: 60-day ROC of the ratio ---
# roc() outputs decimal fraction (e.g., 0.05 = 5% gain)
cg_roc_60 = roc(period=60)(cg_ratio)

# --- Quartile Assignment via 252-day rolling percentile rank ---
# percentrank returns 0-100; quartile thresholds: 25 / 50 / 75
cg_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(cg_roc_60)

# Q1 = bottom 25% (most falling), Q4 = top 25% (most rising)
quartile = conditional_select(
    is_valid(cg_pctrank) and cg_pctrank <= 25, 1,
    is_valid(cg_pctrank) and cg_pctrank <= 50, 2,
    is_valid(cg_pctrank) and cg_pctrank <= 75, 3,
    is_valid(cg_pctrank), 4,
    0
)

# Quartile label string for event markers
quartile_label = conditional_select(
    quartile == 1, 'Q1 (Most Falling)',
    quartile == 2, 'Q2',
    quartile == 3, 'Q3',
    quartile == 4, 'Q4 (Most Rising)',
    'Unranked'
)

# --- Outcome: 63-day SPY forward return ---
spy_fwd_63 = forward_returns(period=63)(spy_close)

# --- Per-quartile forward returns (sparse series) ---
fwd_q1 = where(quartile == 1, spy_fwd_63)
fwd_q2 = where(quartile == 2, spy_fwd_63)
fwd_q3 = where(quartile == 3, spy_fwd_63)
fwd_q4 = where(quartile == 4, spy_fwd_63)

# --- Hit rate: 1 if positive return, 0 if not (per quartile) ---
# Using ternary (not where) so 0 contributes to mean correctly (S41)
hit_q1 = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_q1) and fwd_q1 > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(fwd_q1) else fwd_q1)
hit_q2 = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_q2) and fwd_q2 > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(fwd_q2) else fwd_q2)
hit_q3 = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_q3) and fwd_q3 > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(fwd_q3) else fwd_q3)
hit_q4 = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_q4) and fwd_q4 > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(fwd_q4) else fwd_q4)

bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Chart 1 (Context): Copper/Gold Ratio 60d ROC over time ---
# Dense time series — xy_lines appropriate
xy_lines(
    title='Copper/Gold Ratio 60d Momentum — The Signal Over Time',
    category='Cu/Au Ratio → SPY Returns',
    y_axis_label='60d ROC (decimal)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cu/Au 60d ROC', color=Color.Blue, area=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=cg_roc_60)

# --- Chart 2 (Punchline): Average 63d SPY return by quartile ---
# Sparse event data → xy_bars with Mean aggregation (R12)
xy_bars(
    title='Does Q4 Copper/Gold Momentum Predict Better SPY Returns?',
    category='Cu/Au Ratio → SPY Returns',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg 63d SPY Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 (Most Falling)', color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4 (Most Rising)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4))

# --- Chart 3 (Hit Rate): % of positive 63d SPY returns by quartile ---
xy_bars(
    title='Hit Rate by Quartile — How Often Does SPY Rise 3 Months Later?',
    category='Cu/Au Ratio → SPY Returns',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Hit Rate (% positive outcomes)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% Base Rate')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 (Most Falling)', color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4 (Most Rising)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=3
)(values=(hit_q1, hit_q2, hit_q3, hit_q4))

# --- Summary Table: N, Median, Hit Rate, Best, Worst per quartile ---
# RowSpec GROUP BY mode: values = spy_fwd_63, groupKey = quartile (1-4)
# col_headers = Q1..Q4, rows = N / Median / Hit Rate / Best / Worst
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='3-Month SPY Forward Returns by Cu/Au Ratio Quartile',
        col_headers=['Q1 (Most Falling)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4 (Most Rising)'],
        rows=[
            RowSpec(name='Obs Count', agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            RowSpec(name='Median Return', agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                    color_map={'Success': ['POSITIVE'], 'Error': ['NEGATIVE']}),
            RowSpec(name='Avg Return', agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                    color_map={'Success': ['POSITIVE'], 'Error': ['NEGATIVE']}),
            RowSpec(name='Best', agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            RowSpec(name='Worst', agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Cu/Au Ratio → SPY Returns',
    order=0
)(spy_fwd_63, quartile)
